🔥 Happy Reading folks - reaching joyride levels 🕹️ 💯 I'm discovering them first for you. 

Michael SpencerJul 28, 2023∙ Paid3626Share

Hey Everyone, 

I’m always reading, curating, aggregating articles and Newsletter about A.I. for my audience. You could even say, it’s my full time job. 

Subscribe

As such, I want you to introduce you to a few Newsletters that you should know about. 

They won’t all be from Substack this time. I have excluded hugely popular A.I. Newsletters usually found in such lists and LinkedIn Newsletters from this list. The general idea here is you discover some you’ve never read. 

I have a huge interest in emerging A.I. Newsletters, as I believe in a level playing field. I’m always reading Newsletters related to the future, emerging tech and A.I. as well. 

Here are some of my top new reading recommendations for the second half of 2023 (I hope you enjoy): 

Hunting for Diamonds in the Rough in A.I. Newsletters 

This is going to be a long list potentially, so read on the web by clicking on the title. Bookmark it! Share it. 

Unfortunately Substack does not allow for beehiiv embeds, so in that case I will take a screenshot. 

I’ve already written on the Top AI Newsletter on Substack, now time for something a bit different. This time I’m omitting most of the popular Newsletters, and trying to find some diamonds in the rough. And trust me, there are a lot of those in A.I.  

The Top AI Newsletters on Substack in 2023

Michael Spencer·April 18, 2023Read full storyA.I. Newsletter saturation you say? I’m all in on this, so much good reading! This list is in no specific order. Lost to the SEO game was this reloaded list. 

Share

Let me know in the comments section, who did I miss? 

Leave a comment

Since this is a long list, and if you are serious about browsing it, read it on the web and not in Gmail or your Email provider. 

Every week there are new A.I. Newsletters that arrive, sometimes from established book authors or unknown unknowns in the field. One of the services I offer my readers, is covering those people and alerting you to them. You can pay for early access. 

You might just find that diamond in the rough for the kind of content around A.I. you are seeking.  My aim here is to improve your reading experience of A.I. By supporting me, you are also supporting my work trying to get others more exposure like in my guest post series.
